name: Augustus
title: Princeps / First Emperor
summary: Augustus, also known as Octavian, was the founder of the Roman Empire and the first Roman emperor from 27 BC until his death in AD 14. The reign of Augustus initiated an imperial cult and an era of imperial peace in which the Roman world was largely free of armed conflict. The principate, a style of government where the emperor showed nominal deference to the Senate, was established during his reign and lasted until the Crisis of the Third Century.
notes: He was deified by the Senate after his death. Persistent rumors claim his wife Livia poisoned him. He was succeeded by his stepson Tiberius. The month August is named after him. His regime's facade of restored republican institutions masked autocratic power derived from control of the military and provinces. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Augustus
